comment: S81 HC ref_tile bench template (s81hc-1013). A spec opts in with job.benches_from = this file; ref_tile.py job prepends the lint and appends these. The gate is the whole-HC composition of the job's own source commit in the production shape (tools/s81_suhc/hc_gate_bench.sh): the exact run must PASS and mutant 3 must FAIL, so a CLOSED tile is merge-eligible only with a bit-exact composition of the source it was routed from. Only tiles the production shape instantiates may use it.
